t0027-01.gloss: A hall key and departure record disagree about whether the building was secured before transport left.
t0027-01.rival_reading: A program crew could have used the hall and its transport during ordinary field work; the contradictory door note does not say why the bus left.

t0027-02.gloss: A caretaker's request links a grounds crew, rinsed equipment, and a temporary room restriction.
t0027-02.rival_reading: A response crew could have rinsed equipment and restricted access after an emergency; the note never identifies what treatment reached the grounds.
